title: Deirdre:
headline: A neighbor of MHA's Omaha house had surgery. The people of the house did her yard work. “That's what neighbors do.”
story: Deirdre Evans lives near Terrapin Station and sits on the board of the Joslyn Castle Neighborhood Association. When she had surgery in June, Cynthia texted to ask if they could help, and Jacob came over to do her yard work. They talked about bugs and butterflies.

This is the neighborhood saying who MHA really is: loving and responsible people, good for the whole community. It takes away the fear people may have about a house like this. Light, warm and hopeful.
